name: Midjourney
shortDescription: Image generation. Official plans we read are paid subscriptions, with no free tier on the comparison.
longDescription: Midjourney generates images. The plan comparison lists Basic at $10, Standard at $30, Pro at $60, and Mega at $120 per month, and no free plan. Those figures are from the October 15, 2026 docs article. We did not subscribe.
pricingNotes: No free tier on the official plan chart.
bestFor: Image generation when a paid subscription is acceptable
notIdealFor: A free tier — the official comparison we read does not list one
strength: The plan comparison we read lists Basic at $10, Standard at $30, Pro at $60, and Mega at $120 per month.
weakness: That official plan comparison lists no free plan, so every plan we read is a paid subscription.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
problems: No free tier on the official plan chart.
